definitions.full: H3525. kebel כֶּ֫בֶל noun [masculine] fetter(s) , late; — singular collective ׳בַכּ רגליו עִנּוּ Psa 105:18 they humbled his feet with fetters (|| בַּרְזֶל ); plural construct בַרְזֶל בְּכַבְּלֵי אסר 149:8 (|| זִקִּים ). כבן (√ of following, meaning dubious; Late Hebrew כָּבַן , Aramaic כבן , = wrap round, wrap up ).
